subject: lang-dy
title: LANG.DY.------POL.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 184 (SR(TRS)II-40). LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: IST-F-ALGN, PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From IST-F-ALGN: RE-DOC (redocumentation). From PROG-CONT: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From APP-RDEF: AF-COMP (affinity compression). From RE-DOC: RE-ST (restructuralism). From AF-COMP: CU-AF-B and INFO-DS (information dissemination). From INFO-DS: INT (intention).
